35:def find(x, equation):
36:    """
37:    Checks whether a Symbol matching ``x`` is present in ``equation``
38:    or not. If present, the matching symbol is returned, else a
39:    ValueError is raised. If ``x`` is a string the matching symbol
40:    will have the same name; if ``x`` is a Symbol then it will be
41:    returned if found.
42:
43:    Examples
44:    ========
45:
46:    >>> from sympy.geometry.util import find
47:    >>> from sympy import Dummy
48:    >>> from sympy.abc import x
49:    >>> find('x', x)
50:    x
51:    >>> find('x', Dummy('x'))
52:    _x
53:
54:    The dummy symbol is returned since it has a matching name:
55:
56:    >>> _.name == 'x'
57:    True
58:    >>> find(x, Dummy('x'))
59:    Traceback (most recent call last):
60:    ...
61:    ValueError: could not find x
62:    """
63:
64:    free = equation.free_symbols
65:    xs = [i for i in free if (i.name if isinstance(x, str) else i) == x]
66:    if not xs:
67:        raise ValueError('could not find %s' % x)
68:    if len(xs) != 1:
69:        raise ValueError('ambiguous %s' % x)
70:    return xs[0]
